title: A mining game where everything actually melts (waifu included)
author: Professional_Job_307
selftext:
The game is Meltbelt, you melt asteroids with a laser and sort the molten metal with a tractor beam. It's all Godot with C++ for the liquid sim and heat mechanics.

All of the code, shaders, textures, etc, is written by Opus 5.5 and a little Fable. My workflow is playtest, write a list all the stuff I want changed to Claude, and for all the changes that aren't minor I usually do some brainstorming with Claude to iterate on the ideas before implementing them, testing, and iterating further. It's incredibly easy to get something into the game now with AI, so you get a lot of room to experiment and figure out what works and what doesn't. The only bottleneck is playtesting and iteration.

This has been in development for 3 weeks now, mostly weekends alongside my job, and I'm so happy with how far it has come in such a short amount of time. I actually tried to make this game 5 months ago with GPT-5.5... its version crashed my computer after 5 liquid particles lmao.  
Huh... that was just 5 months ago holy fuck we're going vertical

The game is free and runs in the **browser** if anyone wants to try it, and it even runs on mobile!  
[https://gammapath.itch.io/meltbelt](https://gammapath.itch.io/meltbelt) (may take a couple seconds to load)

And as promised in the title, Wren (the waifu) is in the game and will take you through the tutorial :)

All forms of constructive feedback is greatly appreciated. Let me know where you get stuck or bored.
